svg.title: The Noctiluca loop
svg.desc: Three pillars: the constellation map, the CodeMirror editor with a symbol row, and the Pyodide runtime that lights a star when your output matches.
svg.text: Fifty episodes of twenty stars. Light them in
order or open any level at any time.
CodeMirror 6 tuned for phones, with a symbol row
Pyodide runs your code in a Web Worker and
compares its output with the authored solution.
Your code never leaves your device.
